messages:
nina_cs: Pinwheel emailed saying they hit a sudden wave of 429s during a deploy to eu-west-1. Spike started ~15s after the canary flip.

nina_cs: They pasted a failing request sample: ```POST /v1/sdk/init HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
x-request-id: pw-req-302
x-account-id: pinwheel
Response: 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 12
```

pinwheel-ops: We run the browser SDK in an edge worker. Current bootstrap settings: `ephemeralTTL: 10s`, no init jitter, and our worker restarts in lock-step during this deploy. Observed active clients header: `x-active-clients: 498`.

devon_sdk: Immediate customer guidance: (1) increase ephemeralTTL to 120-300s to reduce auth churn, (2) add a small randomized startup splay/jitter so not everyone init()s at once, (3) ensure edge keepAlive so connections are reused.

ramiro_eng: Infra note: auth validation QPS for pinwheel spiked from 1200->4200 and our auth queue depth hit a short peak. Short-term we can enable per-account validation coalescing (dedupe identical token checks for 10s) behind a feature flag.

edge-ops: I can flip a flag scoped to pinwheel for a 20 minute window to coalesce validations. Will do if Pinwheel agrees to hold on a controlled canary.

onboard-bot: Ticket created CS-#5176: "Pinwheel init 429 spike during deploy". Assigned to ramiro_eng, devon_sdk.

pinwheel-ops: We'll try TTL=180 and add a 0-800ms client jitter on canary (10% for 3m). Starting now. Will send any x-request-id samples if 429s continue.

devon_sdk: If they still see 429s after these mitigations, ask for two failing request ids and a snapshot of `x-active-clients` and `x-client-conns`. We'll correlate with auth queue traces and consider a temporary per-account burst window to smooth the traffic.

ramiro_eng: For longer-term fixes: (a) expose SDK knobs `initSplayMs` and `ephemeralDefaultSecs`, (b) add server-side backpressure headers (e.g., `x-backpressure: please-jitter`) so smart SDKs can respect short windows, (c) improve console alerts when account QPS trips. Filing internal tickets.

nina_cs: Noted. I'll update the customer health log and confirm once the canary completes. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
